SpendSync will read payment alerts from your bank SMS, bank emails (Gmail/Outlook notifications) and UPI apps, and turn them into transactions. A copy of each bank message, with account numbers masked, is saved to your account so it syncs across devices; you can turn copies off or delete them any time. One-time codes are never read or saved. Android will ask you to allow notification access next.
